items.title: X pays selected creators for 15 vertical videos.
items.para: Video Kickstart is invite-only: 15 original clips under three minutes on 15 separate days. Clips first shared elsewhere count.
items.tip: Your Reels and TikToks can double as native X video. Reuse owned clips and test it with a small series.

items.title: LinkedIn adds saves and sends to post analytics.
items.para: Creators can now see how many people saved a post or sent it to someone else.
items.tip: For sponsor and B2B content, track saves and sends as a sign that a post was useful, not just seen.

items.title: Meta's creator assistant now flags trends and drafts replies.
items.para: It also turns an idea into a storyboard, reviews drafts and now works on the web through Creator Dashboard.
items.tip: Use it for planning and first drafts, then keep a human check on every reply that goes out in your club's voice.

items.title: Threads tests Friends, a private list of up to 50.
items.para: Posts are visible only to the list, similar to Close Friends on Instagram. It is a limited test.
items.tip: Watch it for athlete and staff accounts that want a closer circle. Set club guidelines before players use it.

items.title: TikTok opens a brand safety hub for marketers.
items.para: It gathers a Brand Protection Playbook, AI safety guidance and tools to report copyright and trademark infringement.
items.tip: Review it before sponsor activations and use the reporting tools against fake or infringing club content.
